direction.grid: 100vw x 100dvh overflow:hidden; rows 48px header / 44px guide / minmax(0,1fr) main / 56px action bar; at 1366x768 use 184px vertical step rail / minmax(0,1fr) stage at least 55vw x 60vh / 360px inspector; no page scroll, internal scroll only in inspector and task lists; refit tight panels before reducing type; all targets at least 36px
direction.colorTokens: bg #050705, panel #0B100B, raised #121A12, border rgba(197,204,212,.22); silver #C5CCD4 headings and machine bodies, silverDim rgba(197,204,212,.68); neon #A8F04A primary with #050705 text, one primary per viewport; stoppedRed #E5484D reserved exclusively for stopped CELL-MILL-2 outline, cross-hatch and OFFLINE-STOPPED text; official logo immutable black, emerald/neon green and brushed silver at native aspect in exactly two placements: header and opening story, never recolored, cropped, redrawn or duplicated elsewhere
direction.typography: System sans; 24/30 stage title, 15/20 panel title, 13/19 body, 11/14 uppercase micro-labels, 26px tabular metrics; one verb-led instruction and one status sentence per step; minimal narration; enlarge any stage label under 11px to 11px minimum
direction.motion: 160-220ms ease-out selection and panels; one 240ms route trace on real state change, then static; no loops or pulses; prefers-reduced-motion removes transitions while pattern, marker and text still carry meaning; 2px neon focus ring with 2px offset on every interactive element; pointer style only on enabled controls
direction.components: Header 48px with official logo left and Lock recovery room right; opening story carries the second and final logo placement; vertical step rail from one steps array with aria-current, arrow-key movement and 36-40px targets, replacing clipped horizontal scroller; guide strip with no duplicate primary; focusable cinematic factory stage SVG; inspector 360px keeping pre-flight route-health checks for nonce and identity visually and semantically separate from the distinct investigation evidence task, with separate headings, status and controls; action bar 56px with Back left, status centre and one primary right; selecting a recovery option opens the typed consent form; skip-to-stage first, then header, rail, guide, SVG nodes, inspector and action bar in tab order; Enter/Space activate, Esc closes, aria-live polite announces results only
direction.visualizations: State-driven 960x540 SVG using real state only: MAT-ALLOY-A held, 40+30=70 units, feasible routes only in neon, silver for idle machines, red only for stopped CELL-MILL-2, never a route through the offline cell; aligned Certificate 120 versus Receiving 80 tracks with DOES NOT MATCH spanning the gap inside stage bounds; bidirectional SVG-to-inspector highlighting; persistent Running/Held/Blocked/Offline-Stopped/Feasible-Accepted legend using pattern, marker and text; pending task proposals deliberately untracked until human approval, while blocked prior tasks remain visible beside an approved recovery plan as replacement tasks await approval

fixes.change: Replace the clipped horizontal step scroller with the 184px vertical rail so all 9 steps and the completion state are visible at 1366x768 without horizontal overflow.
Keep the header logo as placement one and reserve placement two for the opening story; remove any additional logo rendering from the stage header area.
Enlarge the MAT-ALLOY-A, AWAITING DECISION and legend labels to at least 11px and tighten the lower stage whitespace so jobs, routes and legend fit above the action bar.
Remove the extra logo block inside the stage; it duplicates the header placement and consumes stage width needed for the Certificate and Receiving tracks.
Separate ROUTE HEALTH - PRE-FLIGHT (nonce, identity status) from INVESTIGATION - SOURCE EVIDENCE with distinct headings, borders and controls so the checks are never read as the investigation result.
Refit the factory SVG labels: move DOCK, MAT-ALLOY-A and OA chips off the machine edges and stop the evidence captions overlapping at the bottom of the stage.
Remove the extra stage logo block and use the reclaimed space to keep DOES NOT MATCH fully inside the stage bounds, clear of the Receiving track.

Make the three option cards in the inspector and the three matching stage chips share one selected state, one focus order and bidirectional highlighting; keep USE VERIFIED SUBSTITUTE selected as shown.
Enlarge the typed consent helper text to 11px minimum and keep the 0/27 typed status, exact phrase and disabled Accept state visible without scrolling in the inspector.
Remove the large empty area below the t1-t3 chips in the stage; show all three proposed tasks as compact untracked-until-approval cards so the stage does not read as unfinished.

Show the inspector task list without the nested double border and cramped scroll well: one dashed proposed container, numbered 1-3 targets at 36px, and End of proposal visible without internal scroll at 1366x768.
Keep only one primary: Approve Britt's proposal in the action bar; demote Review proposed tasks and Decline proposal in the inspector to secondary buttons.
Fix the overlapping stage labels around RECEIVING, VERIFIED RECOVERY and MAT-ALLOY-B: offset callouts with leader lines so no text sits on machine edges or route lines.

Make the CELL-MILL-2 preview state distinct from the final stopped state: silver dashed preview outline with PREVIEW - WILL GO OFFLINE text, reserving stoppedRed for the applied offline state in later steps.
Reduce the empty inspector space below Scenario management by grouping cell availability, machine selector and invalidation warning into one compact panel that fits without dead space.

Keep CELL-MILL-2 as the sole red element with cross-hatch and STOPPED / OFFLINE-STOPPED text, and remove the route line segment that visually passes through it so only feasible paths via CELL-MILL-1 glow neon.

Separate ROUTE HEALTH - PRE-FLIGHT (nonce, identity) from INVESTIGATION - SOURCE EVIDENCE as in step 2, with the investigation panel keeping its own not-run status and the stage primary reading Reinvestigate recovery.
Refit the bottom evidence captions and segment strip so Certificate says 120, Receiving counted 80 and Substitute available: 100 do not overlap and remain at least 11px.
Make the constrained Split available capacity card match between stage and inspector: same hatch, x CONSTRAINED label and reason text that it requires at least two online compatible cells.
Keep the typed consent form fully visible after selection: exact phrase, input, 0/27 typed status and disabled Accept revised decision all inside the inspector without clipping at 1366x768.
Enlarge the Revised after capacity change explanatory line to 11px minimum and keep PRIOR ACCEPTANCE INVALIDATED in the action-bar centre status.
Keep the 3 BLOCKED prior tasks and the 3 PROPOSED replacements as two clearly separated, simultaneously visible groups in both stage and inspector; never merge their counts or statuses.
Refit the inspector blocked list so all blocked rows are readable without the narrow nested scroll well, using hatched blocked styling plus text labels rather than color alone.
Truncate the action-bar centre status with an accessible full-text equivalent: Approved revised plan - replacement tasks await approval, keeping Approve revised tasks as the single primary.
Align the three stage cards VERIFY LEDGER / SEAL PACKET / RETAIN CHECKPOINT with the inspector sequence 1-2-3, sharing READY and LOCKED states and bidirectional highlighting.
Keep Verify ledger as the single primary in the action bar and demote the duplicate Verify ledger button inside the inspector to a secondary or status element.
Enlarge the passphrase guidance in the inspector to 11px minimum and keep the separate-passphrase requirement adjacent to its input.

Replace Step 9 of 9 labelling with Recovery story complete in the rail aria-current state, and keep PACKET SEALED - 18 events - revised plan accepted - CELL-MILL-2 offline retained as the sole centre status.
Give the completion screen one clear exit emphasis: keep Back secondary and add no new primary, so the sealed Verify, Seal and Retain cards remain the visual conclusion.
Ensure the three SEALED checkmarks also carry text labels for reduced-motion and non-color reading, and keep the retained evidence summary at least 11px.
